Manifest.Name: Gian Thương
Manifest.Author: New Anime Universe
Manifest.Description: A golden starting perk that adds 5% to the displayed sale price and shows a Gian Thuong (+5%) entry in the Market price breakdown whenever a customer buys the player's goods, grants 50 starting Credits, and lowers every faction's starting reputation by 5. Costs 1 perk point.
